# football-data.co.uk test fixture

`fixtures_2026-11-13.csv` has the **column layout** of `football-data.co.uk/fixtures.csv` as published on
2026-11-13 (divisions, dates, kick-off times, team names, bookmaker columns, and which cells were blank).

**Every price and handicap line in it is synthetic**, generated by a formula. No bookmaker odds from the
source are redistributed here. Tests must not treat these numbers as real quotes.
